name: Box
description: Business connector for Box through the Box API with the customer's own Box app (OAuth 2.0). Read-only by default: search, file metadata, and fetching a file into the Project through quarantine and malware scanning (the model never receives the bytes). Uploading to one configured folder is a separate opt-in and always needs a person's approval.

clientId.description: Client ID of the Box Custom App (User Authentication, OAuth 2.0). The client secret goes in the secret store: connector.box.clientSecret.

searchFolderIds.description: Optional: limit searches to these folder ids (and their subfolders).

upload.description: Allow uploading Project files into uploadFolderId (root_readwrite). Every upload needs a person's approval.

uploadFolderId.description: The one folder uploads go to (not the root folder 0).
